checks.questionEn: Does physics-only operator training learn without information?
checks.questionZh: 纯物理算子训练是在没有信息的情况下学习吗？
checks.answerEn: No. It uses known source functions, a specified differential equation and boundary conditions, with residual constraints for each training function. It avoids paired training-temperature labels. This differs from having no information, and also differs from validation without reference solutions. Independent unseen input functions, shifted residual positions and full-field comparisons remain necessary. Finite residual sampling and sensor encoding do not certify arbitrary-input generalisation.
checks.answerZh: 不是。它利用已知热源函数、指定微分方程以及边界条件，对每个训练函数设置残差约束。省去的是成对训练温度标签，而不是全部信息。评估仍然使用独立参考解、未见输入函数、偏移残差位置以及完整场比较。有限残差采样与传感器编码都不能证明任意输入上的泛化。
